sermon.title: Burning bush, God’s Covenant - December 17, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Continuing the Burning Bush series, the message explains God’s new covenant in Ezekiel 36: a cleansing, a new heart and His Spirit. Like a body, the spiritual man needs a working heart, the life-giving blood of Christ, and the breath of the Spirit that comes by hearing His word; Saul and Lazarus show what happens when we hear and respond.

faqs.question: Has he felt God’s tug?
faqs.answer: He says he has, and many have felt that drawing from God.

faqs.question: Will the new covenant change?
faqs.answer: No matter what God is doing in 2023, 2024 or the next century, we all need it.

faqs.question: Who should take God up on His promises?
faqs.answer: He says hear that, world: take God up on His promises.

faqs.question: What is his medical example?
faqs.answer: A patient whose blood cells are destroyed gets a transplant from someone close to their DNA, and the body makes blood from it.

faqs.question: How many breaths have you taken?
faqs.answer: So many since you got here, each carrying oxygen through your body.

faqs.question: Is hearing music in a store real hearing?
faqs.answer: No; you can walk through and not pay attention.

faqs.question: What was Saul like before?
faqs.answer: All gung-ho, going hard after what he believed.

faqs.question: What is in a tomb?
faqs.answer: No light, creeping things, worms and dirt.

faqs.question: What is the closing exhortation?
faqs.answer: Do not hold your breath; don’t resist the Holy Spirit.
